_readme: Every design token for the whole site lives here. Edit a value, run `node build.js`, refresh. Current system: 'bloom' (2026-08-05) — pulled pixel-by-pixel off assets/hero/flower-source.jpg, the white bloom standing on red felt. THE HIERARCHY IS THE PHOTOGRAPH'S: red is the ground and it now leads (the whole hero is a field of it, and the deep surfaces that used to be teal are oxblood); the petal cream is the one bright thing on that red and so carries every headline over it; the stem green is the quiet second colour and carries display type on the cream pages; the clay accent is unchanged because the photo's lit ground already sat on it. 'ink-display' is that stem green — change that one hex to retune every display heading on the site. 'brand-ink' is the paler sage the client logo wall is masked to (hover deepens to ink-display); it is deliberately quiet — the logos are credentials, not headlines. The 'field-*' four are the hero's red, and they are not free: they are the colours the flower photograph's own background fades out on, so .hero-band's gradient has to arrive at them. Re-run `node tools/make-hero-flower.js` to re-measure them if the crop moves. Previous systems are saved whole: `node tools/design-system.js restore terracotta` (cream + rust + teal-blue display type) or `restore rainforest`.
